europe_now.title: Russian Strikes and Power Grid Disruption in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Russian military operations targeting energy infrastructure have caused widespread power outages across Ukraine, affecting hundreds of thousands of residents. Additionally, reported communication restrictions via Starlink have created disruptions for front-line military missions.

sources.headline: Russian strikes leave 600,000 without power in Ukraine, as Starlink restrictions affect front line
Ukraine says Starlink restricted operations overnight, disrupting military missions

europe_now.title: Police Raid on Turkish Opposition Media
europe_now.summary: Turkish law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on a prominent pro-opposition television station, leading to an abrupt halt in live broadcasts. Station leadership strongly condemned the action as a severe blow to press freedom.

sources.headline: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts

top_stories.title: European Defense and Security Developments
top_stories.summary: A Norwegian defense firm has announced plans to construct a new anti-drone manufacturing facility in Poland. Meanwhile, German legal proceedings have initiated regarding individuals connected to past pipeline sabotage incidents.

sources.headline: Norwegian defence firm Kongsberg to build anti-drone factory in Poland

top_stories.title: Papal Health Updates
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV is currently undergoing a period of medical recovery following a surgical procedure for lung cancer. The faithful have gathered in prayer and support as medical updates are continuously monitored.
